description: This is a main package for conducting benchmarks on the AgentField SDK in Go, measuring registration time, memory footprint, cold start latency, request processing latency, and server throughput, with functions to run a server and perform concurrent requests.

methods.name: calculateStats
methods.description: Computes statistical metrics (mean, std dev, min, max, percentiles) for a dataset of float64 values.

methods.name: percentile
methods.description: Calculates the p-th percentile of a sorted slice of float64.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Executes various benchmarks on the AgentField SDK and outputs summarized statistics or JSON.

methods.name: benchmarkRegistration
methods.description: Measures the time to register a specified number of handlers repeatedly.

methods.name: benchmarkMemory
methods.description: Measures memory usage when creating agents with a certain number of handlers.

methods.name: benchmarkColdStart
methods.description: Measures cold start times for agent instantiation.

methods.name: benchmarkRequestProcessing
methods.description: Measures latency of individual request handling through registered reasoners.

methods.name: runServer
methods.description: Starts a server with specified number of handlers that process incoming requests.

methods.name: benchmarkConcurrentRequests
methods.description: Performs concurrent benchmarking of handler invocation to gauge throughput and latency.
